Chiikawa official manga style educational illustration, 4:3, explaining gcloud CLI configurations. === TITLE === "gcloud CLI 配置管理" — floating typography, NOT anchored to any solid band or box; coral-pink (#FF8E9E) bold rounded font with White Outer Glow and Subtle Drop Shadow for legibility on light backgrounds; surrounded by small pastel flowers, twinkling stars, and tiny hearts woven naturally into the scene === SCENE & LAYOUT === Layout: Network graph, with nodes branching out from a central point Background: Soft gradient cream (#FFF8E7) to sky-blue (#D0E7FF), minimal fluffy clouds === MAIN CONTENT === [CONTENT_SECTION_1] Character: Chiikawa (吉伊) - Chiikawa, the small white round creature with dot eyes, is standing in front of a computer terminal, typing commands with a determined expression. - The terminal displays command-line interface text. Visual: A computer terminal with a gcloud CLI prompt. Label: "gcloud CLI
命令行工具 (Command Line Tool)" — inside a semi-transparent cloud-like blob (marshmallow-soft aesthetic, pure white at 70–80% opacity, NO hard border, soft edges blending into the background) [DIALOGUE_OR_ANNOTATION] Chiikawa (吉伊): "开始使用 gcloud 啦！(Starting to use gcloud!)" [CONTENT_SECTION_2] Character: Hachiware (小八) - Hachiware, the blue cat with the inverted-V forehead marking, is holding a clipboard and pointing at a configuration diagram. He has a calm and explanatory expression. - The diagram shows different configuration options. Visual: A configuration diagram with branching paths. Label: "configurations
配置集合 (Configuration Sets)" — inside a semi-transparent cloud-like blob (marshmallow-soft aesthetic, pure white at 70–80% opacity, NO hard border, soft edges blending into the background) [DIALOGUE_OR_ANNOTATION] Hachiware (小八): "配置集合可以帮助你管理不同的环境。(Configuration sets can help you manage different environments.)" [CONTENT_SECTION_3] Character: Usagi (乌萨奇) - Usagi, the energetic beige rabbit with long ears, is jumping excitedly towards a "dev" environment icon. He looks eager. - The icon represents a development environment. Visual: An icon representing a development environment, with code snippets floating around it. Label: "dev
配置 (dev Configuration)" — inside a semi-transparent cloud-like blob (marshmallow-soft aesthetic, pure white at 70–80% opacity, NO hard border, soft edges blending into the background) [DIALOGUE_OR_ANNOTATION] Usagi (乌萨奇): "开发环境！(Development environment!)" [CONTENT_SECTION_4] Character: Chiikawa (吉伊) - Chiikawa, the small white round creature with dot eyes, is carefully setting up a staging environment. - He is focused and making small adjustments. Visual: An icon representing a staging environment, with test tubes and measuring tools. Label: "staging
配置 (staging Configuration)" — inside a semi-transparent cloud-like blob (marshmallow-soft aesthetic, pure white at 70–80% opacity, NO hard border, soft edges blending into the background) [DIALOGUE_OR_ANNOTATION] Chiikawa (吉伊): "准备发布啦！(Preparing to release!)" [CONTENT_SECTION_5] Character: Hachiware (小八) - Hachiware, the blue cat with the inverted-V forehead marking, is overseeing a production environment with a reassuring smile. - The environment appears stable and well-monitored. Visual: An icon representing a production environment, with server racks and monitoring dashboards. Label: "prod
配置 (prod Configuration)" — inside a semi-transparent cloud-like blob (marshmallow-soft aesthetic, pure white at 70–80% opacity, NO hard border, soft edges blending into the background) [DIALOGUE_OR_ANNOTATION] Hachiware (小八): "生产环境一切正常。(Everything is normal in the production environment.)" Project! Region! Zone!)" [CONTENT_SECTION_7] Character: Chiikawa (吉伊) - Chiikawa, the small white round creature with dot eyes, is carefully checking configurations for account, project, region and zone settings. - He has a checklist in his hand. Visual: A checklist confirming account, project, region, and zone settings. Label: "account
project
region/zone" — inside a semi-transparent cloud-like blob (marshmallow-soft aesthetic, pure white at 70–80% opacity, NO hard border, soft edges blending into the background) [DIALOGUE_OR_ANNOTATION] Chiikawa (吉伊): "检查账号、项目和区域/可用区。(Checking account, project, and region/zone.)" [CONTENT_SECTION_8] Character: Hachiware (小八) - Hachiware, the blue cat with the inverted-V forehead marking, is monitoring account, project, region and zone settings with a calm expression. - He is using a dashboard to observe the settings. Visual: A monitoring dashboard displaying account, project, region, and zone settings. Label: "account
project
region/zone" — inside a semi-transparent cloud-like blob (marshmallow-soft aesthetic, pure white at 70–80% opacity, NO hard border, soft edges blending into the background) [DIALOGUE_OR_ANNOTATION] Hachiware (小八): "监控账号、项目和区域/可用区。(Monitoring account, project, and region/zone.)" === KEY CONCEPTS === 4 floating info boxes; each box uses a semi-transparent cloud-like blob background (marshmallow-soft, pure white at 70–80% opacity, no hard border), text in dark charcoal (#2D2D2D), medium-weight sans-serif: Box 1: "gcloud CLI: 命令行工具，用于管理 Google Cloud 资源。(Command-line tool for managing Google Cloud resources.)" Box 2: "配置集合: 允许你管理不同的环境设置。(Allows you to manage different environment settings.)" Box 3: "开发环境 (dev): 用于开发和测试代码的环境。(Environment for developing and testing code.)" Box 4: "生产环境 (prod): 实际运行应用程序的环境。(Environment where the application is actually running.)" === CHIIKAWA STYLE === Official Chiikawa aesthetic: round bodies, large sparkly eyes, pink blush marks, tiny limbs, super deformed proportions, gentle line art === TEXT RENDERING === Typography rules (CRITICAL — apply to every label, title, and annotation): - Title: floating typography with White Outer Glow or Subtle Drop Shadow — NO solid background band; title integrates naturally into the illustrated scene with decorative Chiikawa elements around it - All labels placed inside semi-transparent cloud-like blobs (marshmallow-soft, pure white at 70–80% opacity, no hard borders) — soft edges naturally blend into the illustrated background - Font: bold (600–700) rounded sans-serif for title; medium-weight (500–600) for labels; NO thin, cursive, or brush-stroke fonts - Text color: dark charcoal (#2D2D2D) on the light blob background; minimum contrast 4.5:1 - Chinese characters: every stroke and radical must be Fully Formed and Vector-style clarity — no hairline breaks, no missing components, no pixelation - Smooth anti-aliased edges; absolutely NO cracked, fragmented, or glitchy strokes === MOOD === Friendly, Educational, cute but informative Quality: High-quality Chiikawa illustration, clear visual hierarchy, for documentation
